days.title: Northern Summits and Huts
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Storvigelen
stops.detail: The largest mountain in the park is Storvigelen at 1,561 m above sea level, which is located in the northern part.

stops.name: Muggsjølia
stops.detail: Throughout the national park there are numerous marked hiking trails and also two overnight huts, the Muggsjølia and the Røvollen.
